results.title: Sir Anthony Hopkins: 'I always wanted to be a musician. Now I've finally done it'
results.description: 'I wanted to be a musician but I didn't have the skills to apply to be a musician. I became an actor instead. And some music has been with me all my life, you know, been in part of my life.'
